text:
olivia: FYI renewal dispute from PineBridge Health. They say a reseller "grandfathered" discount was supposed to continue after Private migration; billing shows full platform_fee applied starting 2026-07-01. Customer escalated. Invoice: https://invoices.internal/INV-8124 cc @maria

sam: I pulled the contract. Reseller agreement (SOW Reseller-2024-07) had a clause: 'Customers acquired via Partner X receive 15% recurring discount on platform fees for duration of partnership.' No explicit end date. Migration add-on was billed 07/01 which triggered private-license rate.

maria: Account exec notes in SFDC: partner committed to grandfather pricing through 2027 for pipeline customers, but ambiguous whether that survives product tier change. Customer claims sales verbally confirmed it would. We need evidence.

dennis: From billing system: 
```
INV-8124 lines:
platform_fee    24,000.00   07/01/2026 - 06/30/2027
private_migration_addon  3,500.00  one-time 07/01/2026
```
No discount line applied. System applied standard private tier rates.

maria: Sales-bot shows a note: "partner: grandfather price approved for PineBridge - verbal confirmation 2026-06-15" but no signed addendum. Attached is email chain where AE confirms intent but doesn't sign pricing change.

olivia: Customer insists that verbal ok should carry. Legal (courtney) - do we have precedent for honoring verbal partner commitments where reseller agreement ambiguous?

courtney: Legal: verbal commitments are risky. We can offer a remedial true-up credit as a one-time customer concession (customer success play) but note it as non-precedent. We need an approver from finance for material credits >$5k. Also require sales to add signed addendum for future.

maria: Customer asked for credit equal to 15% off platform_fee for the year: 15% of 24,000 = 3,600. They also asked that migration_addon be waived. Total request = 7,100.

dennis: Quick checks: If we apply 15% discount on annual platform_fee = -3,600. Waiving addon = -3,500. Total credit = -7,100. GL: use 4-115-PartnerCredits for discount portion and 4-102-OnboardCredits for addon waiver? Confirmable?

sales-bot: Sales: recommend splitting: credit platform_fee via partner-credit GL and issue one-time goodwill credit for addon (OPS budget). Sales will get signed addendum.

sam: For finance sign-off: we need internal approval. Material credit threshold >$5k requires Luke or CFO signoff. @olivia escalate?

olivia: Looping Luke. Luke, please review proposed credits: partner discount -$3,600 (GL 4-115), addon waiver -$3,500 (GL 4-102). Total -$7,100. Customer will sign addendum within 7 days.

billing-bot: Credit proposal recorded: TICKET-3456 amount -7100.00 status: pending exec approval.

luke: Approve goodwill add-on waiver up to $4k and partner-credit up to $4k for documented partner cases where sales commit and attach follow-up addendum. Approving this instance. GL posting as proposed. Add audit note: "PineBridge partner-grandfather remediation - verbal commit 2026-06-15"

courtney: Legal: require sales to upload signed addendum within 10 business days; otherwise credit revocation clause must be in memo. We'll prepare a standard addendum template.

maria: Notifying customer: offering a one-time credit of $7,100 applied to INV-8124; no cash refund. We'll apply credit memo and require signed addendum by 2026-08-10 to keep grandfathering going forward. Customer agreed to sign.

dennis: Creating ADJ: ADJ-11009 amount -7100.00 pending final posting. Posting GLs: 4-115-PartnerCredits (-3600), 4-102-OnboardCredits (-3500).

billing-bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-11009 amount -7100.00 status: posted. Links: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-11009

maria: Closing: updated revenue ops and partner billing experiment dashboard. Will follow up to confirm addendum uploaded. Customer notified and ticket closed pending doc. :white_check_mark:
